record.question: Why is good personal and community hygiene crucial for preventing disease outbreaks?
options: It improves a community's economic status.
It stops the cycle of disease transmission from one person to another and throughout the environment.
It makes it easier to track disease patterns.
record.explanation: Answer C: It stops the cycle of disease transmission from one person to another and throughout the environment.. Hygiene interrupts transmission routes between people and through the environment. Reference: https://aerb.gov.in/english/radiation-protection-principle; https://aerb.gov.in/images/PDF/DiagnosticRadiology/REGULATORY-REQUIREMENTS-FOR-DIAGNOSTIC-RADIOLOGY-PRACTICE.pdf; https://nucleus.iaea.org/sites/nss-oui/Published%20Chunks/m_60b8e698-4f59-4c24-809a-dfb819ac5050/c_92a88144-44da-418c-a878-9c778590e687__9_0.Html.
